components.description: Collection of triangular nodes d₀, d¹₁, dⁱⱼ, … that receive parameters θ and corresponding reward signals and emit individual policies π.

components.name: Ensemble
components.description: Aggregator that combines the individual policies π into a single ensemble policy.

components.name: Ensemble policy
components.description: Final policy output produced by the Ensemble block.

components.name: Designer
components.description: External agent providing shaping potential Φ to the system.

components.name: C
components.description: Parameter set C that modulates the Scaling block.

components.name: Time Series Dataset Φ
components.description: Collection of labeled time–series instances (TS₁ … TSₙ) from Class A and Class B that serve as input.

components.name: Candidate Shapelet Generation
components.description: Procedure that scans every time-series in Φ to extract all possible subsequences and treat them as shapelet candidates.

components.name: Candidate Shapelets (W1..Wn)
components.description: The full set of subsequences W₁, W₂ … Wₙ produced by the generation step.

components.name: Shapelet Distance Calculation
components.description: Module that slides each candidate shapelet over every time-series and records the minimum distance dS,i for each pair.

components.name: Shapelet Quality Assessment
components.description: Computes information-gain values IG₁ … IGₙ at possible split points on the distance vector and assigns IG(S)=max(IG₁ … IGₙ).

components.name: Shapelet Discovery (S1..Sr)
components.description: Ranks all candidates by IG and selects the top r shapelets S₁ … Sᵣ.

components.name: Shapelet Transform
components.description: Converts every original time-series into a feature vector of distances to the discovered shapelets.

components.name: Feature Matrix G
components.description: Resulting matrix whose columns are shapelets S₁ … Sᵣ and whose rows are distance features for each time-series plus the class label.

components.name: Input U
components.description: External control or velocity input U applied to the system.

components.name: robot kinematics
components.description: Computes the nominal robot motion and sensor output Y from input U (Ẋ = X Uᵛ,  Y = h(X)).

components.name: dynamic extension
components.description: Generates an extended state X_e driven by the same input U (Ẋ_e = X_e Uᵛ).

components.name: fixing landmarks
components.description: Observer that stabilises landmark positions using measurement innovation ż = ρ φ̄ (y − φ̄ᵀ ż).

components.name: projection block
components.description: Computes quantities Π_i = Π_Q y_i and q = Π·ξ from Y and X_e for parameter estimation.

components.name: landmark observer (Proposition 1)
components.description: Landmark observer in {V} that uses (Φ, qᵉ) to estimate landmark-related variables z̃_i^v.

components.name: pose observer (Proposition 2)
components.description: Observer that fuses U, X_e, and landmark estimates to output the pose estimates (X̂, Ẑ).

components.name: Estimated pose output
components.description: Sink node representing the resulting pose estimates (X̂, Ẑ).

components.name: Markov chain Monte Carlo
components.description: Sampling step that produces a sequence of configurations {x: x1 … x_NMCS} drawn from the distribution |ψ_θ(x)|^μ.

components.name: Generate {x'}
components.description: Creates a new set of configurations {x'} that satisfy the Hamiltonian connectivity condition ⟨x|H|x'⟩ ≠ 0.

components.name: Obtain representative states
components.description: Reduces the sets {x},{x'} to symmetry-unique representatives {x_rep},{x'_rep} together with sign factors s_x, s_x' = ±1.

components.name: Calculate wave function
components.description: Evaluates the neural-network wave function ψ_θ on the representative states x_rep and x'_rep.

components.name: Calculate energy and variance
components.description: Uses the evaluated wave function to compute the local energies, the expectation value ⟨E_θ⟩ and the variance ⟨V_θ⟩.

components.name: Update NNs to minimize loss function
components.description: Updates the network parameters θ by stochastic gradient descent on the loss ∇_θ L_θ = (1-λ)∇_θ⟨E_θ⟩ + λ∇_θ⟨V_θ⟩.

components.name: CDL module
components.description: Top stage for compensated detail learning that fuses higher-level feature Zi+1 with current feature Ci to generate refined feature Ti.

components.name: Input feature Zi+1
components.description: Higher-level feature map entering the CDL module.

components.name: Input feature Ci
components.description: Current-stage feature map entering the CDL module.

components.name: CDL upsample and projection branch
components.description: Zi+1 is upsampled and passed through a 1x1 convolution before fusion.

components.name: CDL Ci projection branches
components.description: Ci is split into two 1x1 convolution branches, one for concatenation-based detail generation and one for gating/multiplication.

components.name: Concatenation and 3x3 convolution block
components.description: Fuses projected Zi+1 and Ci features, then applies 3x3 convolution and softmax to produce a spatial/detail weighting map.

components.name: CDL gating multiplication
components.description: Element-wise multiplication between the softmax detail map and the projected Ci branch to produce Ti.

components.name: Output feature Ti
components.description: Refined feature output from CDL and input to the Shape-Aware Module.

components.name: Shape-Aware Module
components.description: Middle stage that extracts multi-scale shape-aware cues from Ti and predicts saliency-related supervision while producing Hi.

components.name: Multi-scale feature extraction stack
components.description: Repeated cube-like feature blocks operating on Ti to capture shape information at multiple scales.

components.name: Shape feature fusion block
components.description: Concatenation of multi-scale features followed by 1x1 convolution.

components.name: Residual/addition node
components.description: Combines transformed shape features with a skip connection from the module input.

components.name: MLP saliency prediction head
components.description: Head connected to the fused shape representation for saliency-related prediction.

components.name: Saliency loss block
components.description: Loss term L_sal,i supervised by a saliency/shape target map.

components.name: Output feature Hi
components.description: Shape-aware feature map produced by the Shape-Aware Module and sent to REGA.

components.name: REGA module
components.description: Bottom stage for robust enhancement and gating that combines temporal/task features with Hi and a mask to produce Zi.

components.name: Input features Xt1,i and Xt2,i
components.description: Two input feature maps entering REGA.

components.name: Input feature Hi to REGA
components.description: Shape-aware feature from the previous module.

components.name: Feature concatenation and conv-sigmoid branch
components.description: Xt1,i, Xt2,i, and Hi are concatenated, processed by convolution, and passed through a sigmoid to generate a gating signal.

components.name: Mask input M and mask fusion
components.description: External mask input transformed into a mask vector and added to the learned gating signal.

components.name: Dual gating multipliers
components.description: The fused gate modulates Xt1,i and Xt2,i separately to produce It1,i and It2,i.

components.name: CCL block
components.description: Final fusion/enhancement block that takes gated features It1,i and It2,i.

components.name: Output feature Zi
components.description: Final output feature map from REGA.

arrows.source: Mask input M and mask fusion

components.name: Input Frames
components.description: Stack of five consecutive video frames (I_T-2, I_T-1, I_T, I_T+1, I_T+2) that serve as the raw visual input.

components.name: Encoder E
components.description: Green vertical encoder block that converts each input frame into a grid-shaped feature map.

components.name: Encoded Feature Grids
components.description: Five blue-outlined grids containing blue (discrepancy) and peach (consistency) cells; one per input frame.

components.name: Weight Matrix W^l
components.description: Set of long-range (residual) affinity weights applied via matrix multiplication; indicated above/below the feature stacks.

components.name: Weight Matrix W^s
components.description: Set of short-range (vanilla) affinity weights applied via matrix multiplication; indicated near the middle feature stacks.

components.name: Matrix Multiplication (⊗)
components.description: Operation nodes (⊗) that combine feature grids with the corresponding weight matrices.

components.name: Residual Affinity Paths
components.description: Green dashed arrows connecting feature grids to matrix-multiplication nodes, denoting residual affinity.

components.name: Vanilla Affinity Paths
components.description: Orange dashed arrows connecting feature grids to matrix-multiplication nodes, denoting vanilla affinity.

components.name: Updated Feature Grids
components.description: Grids produced after the weighted matrix multiplication; include green residual cells and peach consistency cells.

components.name: ResBlock
components.description: Blue rectangular residual block that aggregates the set of updated feature grids.

components.name: Aggregated Output Grid
components.description: Final single grid on the far right with orange-brown cells representing the fused/aggregated result.

components.name: Legend
components.description: Key explaining symbols and color codes: matrix multiplication symbol, discrepancy area, consistency area, residual area, aggregated area, residual affinity, vanilla affinity.

components.description: Ranks individuals by Pareto dominance.

components.description: Creates a new offspring population through variation operators.

components.name: Combine the populations
